issues: Initial 45/15/25W lighting clipped clay values; reduced to5/2/3W before judging form
At matched low lighting: nose projection/pointed chin and broad lip ridges were excessive relative to supplied drawings

iteration02_changes.nose: Reduce protrusion and raise nose tip; retain an independently editable bridge
iteration02_changes.jaw: Reduce side/back lift; multiply side lift by 1-cos(theta) to soften sharp front chin
iteration02_changes.lips: Replace broad Gaussian lip spread with compact mouth-width mask and small cupid-arc/seam
iteration02_changes.scope: Deterministic local form correction from observed defects, not a paid regeneration or new character approval

iteration03_changes.reason: In neutral front comparison the eye-to-chin extent was too long relative to interpupil width; underjaw cap remained pointed
iteration03_changes.proportion: Scale lower-face Z by .75 about eyeZ .110m; projected source ratio is used as a design target, not 3D measurement
iteration03_changes.jaw: Linear fade over .110m keeps row order monotonic; close underside with explicit inner control rings rather than one warped ngon
iteration03_changes.neck: Shorter connection stub, not final body/neck fit

iteration04_changes.reason: Linear jaw-lift falloff left a slope discontinuity at the rear skull
iteration04_changes.correction: Use cosine falloff over .160m; bounded derivative keeps ring height ordering and removes hard cutoff
iteration04_changes.scope: Local deterministic correction; no new paid generation
